20:             LogAndShow(args.Exception, "UI thread");

22:         };
23:

25:         {
26:             LogAndShow(args.ExceptionObject as Exception, "background thread (fatal)");
27:         };
28: 
29:         System.Threading.Tasks.TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException += (_, args) =>
30:         {
31:             LogAndShow(args.Exception, "async task");
32:             args.SetObserved();
33:         };
34:     }
35: 
36:     private static void LogAndShow(Exception? ex, string where)
37:     {
38:         var text = $"[{DateTime.Now}] Unhandled exception on {where}:\n{ex}\n\n";
39:         try
40:         {
41:             Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(LogPath)!);
42:             File.AppendAllText(LogPath, text);
43:         }
44:         catch

46:             // If we can't even write the log, fall through to the message box anyway.
47:         }

50:             $"An unexpected error occurred on the {where}:\n\n{ex?.Message}\n\n" +
51:             $"Full details were saved to:\n{LogPath}",

1: using System;
2: using System.Collections.Generic;
3: using System.Linq;
4: using System.Net.Http;
5: using System.Text.Json;
6: using System.Threading.Tasks;
7: 
8: namespace PZWorkshopDownloader.Services;
9: 
10: /// <summary>
11: /// One mod's visual + classification data pulled from Steam's public
12: /// GetPublishedFileDetails endpoint: the preview image URL and the tag list.
13: /// WorkshopApiService is intentionally untouched (it stays minimal), so this
14: /// service exists to grab the extra fields (preview_url / tags) the app now
15: /// needs for thumbnails and the tag filter sidebar. Requests are batched
16: /// (up to 100 ids per call) so one request covers all installed mods.
17: /// </summary>
18: public class WorkshopVisual
19: {
20:     public string Id { get; set; } = "";
21:     public string PreviewUrl { get; set; } = "";
22:     public List<string> Tags { get; set; } = new();
23: }
24: 
25: public static class WorkshopVisualService
26: {
27:     private const string Endpoint =
28:         "https://api.steampowered.com/ISteamRemoteStorage/GetPublishedFileDetails/v1/";
29: 
30:     private const int MaxPerRequest = 100;
31: 
32:     private static readonly HttpClient Http = new();
33: 
34:     /// <summary>
35:     /// Fetches preview_url + tags for the given workshop ids in as few API
36:     /// calls as possible. Never throws for an individual item; a hard network
37:     /// failure throws and is caught by the caller.
38:     /// </summary>
39:     public static async Task<Dictionary<string, WorkshopVisual>> GetVisualsAsync(IEnumerable<string> ids)
40:     {
41:         var idList = ids.Where(id => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)).Distinct().ToList();
42:         var result = new Dictionary<string, WorkshopVisual>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
43: 
44:         foreach (var chunk in Chunks(idList, MaxPerRequest))
45:         {
46:             var content = new Dictionary<string, string> { ["itemcount"] = chunk.Count.ToString() };
47:             for (int i = 0; i < chunk.Count; i++)
48:                 content[$"publishedfileids[{i}]"] = chunk[i];
49: 
50:             var resp = await Http.PostAsync(Endpoint, new FormUrlEncodedContent(content));
51:             resp.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
52: 
53:             using var doc = JsonDocument.Parse(await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync());
54:             var list = doc.RootElement.GetProperty("response").GetProperty("publishedfiledetails");
55: 
56:             foreach (var el in list.EnumerateArray())
57:             {
58:                 var id = GetString(el, "publishedfileid");
59:                 if (id == null) continue;
60: 
61:                 var visual = new WorkshopVisual
62:                 {
63:                     Id = id,
64:                     PreviewUrl = GetString(el, "preview_url") ?? "",
65:                 };
66:                 if (el.TryGetProperty("tags", out var tags) && tags.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array)
67:                 {
68:                     foreach (var t in tags.EnumerateArray())
69:                         if (t.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && t.TryGetProperty("tag", out var tag))
70:                             visual.Tags.Add(tag.ToString());
71:                 }
72:                 result[id] = visual;
73:             }
74:         }
75:         return result;
76:     }
77: 
78:     private static IEnumerable<List<string>> Chunks(List<string> list, int size)
79:     {
80:         for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i += size)
81:             yield return list.GetRange(i, Math.Min(size, list.Count - i));
82:     }
83: 
84:     private static string? GetString(JsonElement el, string prop) =>
85:         el.TryGetProperty(prop, out var v) && v.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Null ? v.ToString() : null;
86: }

<Window x:Class="PZWorkshopDownloader.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        xmlns:wv2="clr-namespace:Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf;assembly=Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Wpf"
        Title="Project Zomboid Workshop Downloader"
        Height="880" Width="1300" MinHeight="600" MinWidth="900"
        FontSize="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"
        Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">

    <Window.Resources>

        <!-- Batch 4: shared tile thumbnail block (initial-letter placeholder until
             ThumbnailPath arrives; the image then covers it). Width/Height follow
             the app-wide ModTileSize resource so the slider resizes every tile. -->
        <DataTemplate x:Key="TileThumbnail">
            <Grid Width="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}" Height="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}">
                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="6"
                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="26" FontWeight="Bold"
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </Border>
                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="2.5">
                    <Image.Style>
                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                            <Style.Triggers>
                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                </DataTrigger>
                            </Style.Triggers>
                        </Style>
                    </Image.Style>
                </Image>
            </Grid>
        </DataTemplate>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="DownloadsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Remove From List" Click="RemoveDownloadEntry_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="InstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Folder" Click="OpenFolder_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.FullPath, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Update This Mod" Click="UpdateSingleMod_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.NeedsUpdate, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Force Redownload" Click="ForceRedownloadMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Show Dependencies" Click="ShowDeps_Click"
                      IsEnabled="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.HasDependencies, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Uninstall" Click="UninstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <ContextMenu x:Key="UninstalledModsRowContextMenu">
            <MenuItem Header="Reinstall" Click="ReinstallMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <MenuItem Header="Open Mod Page" Click="ModPage_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag.Id, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
            <Separator/>
            <MenuItem Header="Forget" Click="ForgetUninstalledMod_Click"
                      Tag="{Binding PlacementTarget.Tag, RelativeSource={RelativeSource AncestorType=ContextMenu}}"/>
        </ContextMenu>

        <!-- ============ Tile mode (Batch 4) ============
             Shared styles so all three tile grids stay consistent.
             NOTE: we pulse via Opacity (DoubleAnimation), never by animating a
             brush Color. WPF freezes SolidColorBrush instances inside shared
             DataTemplates, so ColorAnimation on (Foreground).(SolidColorBrush.Color)
             throws "Cannot animate on an immutable object instance". -->

        <!-- Common chrome for every tile button. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{DynamicResource BorderCol}"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,0,10,10"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="Width" Value="{DynamicResource ModTileSize}"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Mod name text (Installed tiles turn orange+bold when an update is out). -->
        <Style x:Key="TileNameTextStyle" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="TextWrapping" Value="Wrap"/>
            <Setter Property="TextAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="MaxHeight" Value="34"/>
            <Setter Property="Margin" Value="0,4,0,2"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="{DynamicResource UIFontSizeGeneral}"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Status line shared appearance. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileStatusTextBase" TargetType="TextBlock">
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="11"/>
            <Setter Property="HorizontalAlignment" Value="Center"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight" Value="Bold"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#3EB489"/>
        </Style>

        <!-- Update status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when NeedsUpdate. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileUpdateStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding NeedsUpdate}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileUpdatePulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileUpdatePulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Requirement status: solid green, orange + opacity pulse when HasMissingDeps. -->
        <Style x:Key="TileRequirementStatusText" TargetType="TextBlock" BasedOn="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}">
            <Style.Triggers>
                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding HasMissingDeps}" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FF8C00"/>
                    <DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                        <BeginStoryboard x:Name="TileRequirementPulse">
                            <Storyboard>
                                <DoubleAnimation Storyboard.TargetProperty="Opacity"
                                                 From="1.0" To="0.45"
                                                 Duration="0:0:0.9" AutoReverse="True" RepeatBehavior="Forever"/>
                            </Storyboard>
                        </BeginStoryboard>
                    </DataTrigger.EnterActions>
                    <DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                        <StopStoryboard BeginStoryboardName="TileRequirementPulse"/>
                    </DataTrigger.ExitActions>
                </DataTrigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

    </Window.Resources>

    <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            <ColumnDefinition x:Name="QueueColumn" Width="0"/>
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <TabControl x:Name="MainTabs" Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                    BorderThickness="0" Margin="0">

            <!-- ============ BROWSER TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Browser" x:Name="BrowserTabItem">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <!-- Address bar -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,4">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="◀" Click="Back_Click" ToolTip="Back"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="1" Content="▶" Click="Forward_Click" ToolTip="Forward"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="⌂" Click="Home_Click" ToolTip="Workshop Home"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="AddressBar" Grid.Column="3" Margin="6,0,0,0"
                                 VerticalContentAlignment="Center" KeyDown="AddressBar_KeyDown"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- Action buttons -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,0,8,6">
                        <TextBlock Text="Folder:" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="3"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="DestFolderLabel" Text="Not set" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,10,0" MaxWidth="260"
                                   TextTrimming="CharacterEllipsis"/>
                        <Button Content="Download This Mod/Collection" Click="DownloadCurrent_Click" Margin="20,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Content="Add To Queue" Click="AddToQueue_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Browser -->
                    <wv2:WebView2 x:Name="Browser" Grid.Row="2"
                                  Source="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=108600&browsesort=trend&section=readytouseitems"/>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ DOWNLOADS TAB ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Downloads">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,8,8,0">
                        <Button Content="Clear Finished" Click="ClearFinishedDownloads_Click"/>
                        <Button Content="Clear All" Click="ClearAllDownloads_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadsGrid">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource DownloadsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">
                                                            <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                                            <Style.Triggers>
                                                                <DataTrigger Binding="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Value="">
                                                                    <Setter Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                                                </DataTrigger>
                                                            </Style.Triggers>
                                                        </Style>
                                                    </Image.Style>
                                                </Image>
                                            </Grid>
                                        </DataTemplate>
                                    </DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                </DataGridTemplateColumn>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Status" Binding="{Binding Status}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Mod" Binding="{Binding Title}" Width="*"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Detail" Binding="{Binding Detail}" Width="280"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Started" Binding="{Binding StartedAt}" Width="100"/>
                                <DataGridTextColumn Header="Finished" Binding="{Binding FinishedAt}" Width="100"/>
                            </DataGrid.Columns>
                        </DataGrid>

                        <ScrollViewer Visibility="{Binding Visibility, ElementName=DownloadsTiles}" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                            <ItemsControl x:Name="DownloadsTiles" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,2,0,0">
                                <ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                    <ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                        <WrapPanel/>
                                    </ItemsPanelTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemsPanel>
                                <ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                                    <DataTemplate>
                                        <Button Click="ModPage_Click" Tag="{Binding}"
                                                Style="{StaticResource TileButtonStyle}"
                                                ContextMenu="{StaticResource DownloadsRowContextMenu}"
                                                ToolTip="{Binding Title}">
                                            <StackPanel>
                                                <ContentControl Content="{Binding}" ContentTemplate="{StaticResource TileThumbnail}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Title}" Style="{StaticResource TileNameTextStyle}"/>
                                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Status}" Style="{StaticResource TileStatusTextBase}"
                                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"/>
                                            </StackPanel>
                                        </Button>
                                    </DataTemplate>
                                </ItemsControl.ItemTemplate>
                            </ItemsControl>
                        </ScrollViewer>
                    </Grid>
                </Grid>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ============ INSTALLED MODS TAB (also handles update checking) ============ -->
            <TabItem Header="Installed Mods" x:Name="InstalledModsTabItem">
                <Grid Background="{DynamicResource BgDark}">
                    <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                        <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                    </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                    <Grid Grid.Row="0" Margin="8,8,8,0">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <Button Grid.Column="0" Content="Refresh Mod List" Click="RefreshDownloadedMods_Click"/>
                        <Button x:Name="UpdateAllButton" Grid.Column="1" Content="Update All" Click="UpdateAllButton_Click"
                                IsEnabled="False" Margin="10,3,3,3"
                                Background="{DynamicResource AccentGreen}" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="2" Content="Export List..." Click="ExportModList_Click" Margin="10,3,3,3"/>
                        <Button Grid.Column="3" Content="Import List..." Click="ImportModList_Click"/>
                        <TextBlock x:Name="UpdatesAvailableText" Grid.Column="4"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                   HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0,0,10,0"
                                   Text="Mods with updates available: 0"/>
                    </Grid>

                    <!-- View toggle + tile size + tag sidebar collapse -->
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                        <Button x:Name="TagSidebarToggle" Content="◀" Click="ToggleTagSidebar_Click"
                                Padding="8,3" Margin="14,0,0,0" ToolTip="Toggle tag filter sidebar"/>
                    </StackPanel>

                    <!-- Content: tag filter sidebar + list/tiles -->
                    <Grid Grid.Row="2" Margin="8,0,8,8">
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition x:Name="TagSidebarColumn" Width="190"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                        <!-- Tag filter sidebar -->
                        <Border Grid.Column="0" Margin="0,0,8,0" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                                BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="4"
                                Padding="8">
                            <DockPanel>
                                <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="Filter by tag"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                                <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Top" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,6">
                                    <Button Content="Select All" Click="SelectAllTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11"/>
                                    <Button Content="Clear" Click="ClearTags_Click" Padding="6,2" FontSize="11" Margin="6,0,0,0"/>
                                </StackPanel>
                                <TextBlock x:Name="TagCountText" DockPanel.Dock="Top" Text="0 tag(s)"
                                           Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" FontSize="11" Margin="0,0,0,4"/>
                                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto" HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled">
                                    <StackPanel x:Name="TagFilterPanel"/>
                                </ScrollViewer>
                            </DockPanel>
                        </Border>

                        <DataGrid x:Name="DownloadedModsGrid" Grid.Column="1">
                            <DataGrid.RowStyle>
                                <Style TargetType="DataGridRow">
                                    <Setter Property="Tag" Value="{Binding}"/>
                                    <Setter Property="ContextMenu" Value="{StaticResource InstalledModsRowContextMenu}"/>
                                    <Style.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#1EFFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </Style.Triggers>
                                </Style>
                            </DataGrid.RowStyle>
                            <DataGrid.Columns>
                                <DataGridTemplateColumn Header="" Width="42" SortMemberPath="ModName">
                                    <DataGridTemplateColumn.CellTemplate>
                                        <DataTemplate>
                                            <Grid Width="32" Height="32">
                                                <Border Background="{DynamicResource BgField}" CornerRadius="4"
                                                        BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1">
                                                    <TextBlock Text="{Binding Initial}" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                                                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.45"
                                                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                                                </Border>
                                                <Image Source="{Binding ThumbnailPath}" Stretch="UniformToFill" Margin="1.5">
                                                    <Image.Style>
                                                        <Style TargetType="Image">

474:     /// <summary>
475:     /// Figures out which Steam Workshop id a local mod folder corresponds to.
476:     /// Tries the "<id> <name>" naming convention this app installs mods
477:     /// under first, then falls back to scanning any mod.info file inside for
478:     /// a purely-numeric id= line (some mods happen to use one).
479:     /// </summary>
480:     private static bool TryExtractWorkshopId(string folderPath, out string id)
481:     {
482:         id = "";
483:         var name = Path.GetFileName(folderPath);
484:         if (name.StartsWith("_")) return false; // skip internal folders like _backups
485: 
486:         var m = Regex.Match(name, @"^(\d+)");
487:         if (m.Success)
488:         {
489:             id = m.Groups[1].Value;
490:             return true;
491:         }
492: 
493:         try
494:         {
495:             foreach (var infoFile in Directory.EnumerateFiles(folderPath, "mod.info", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
496:             {
497:                 foreach (var line in File.ReadAllLines(infoFile))
498:                 {
499:                     var lm = Regex.Match(line.Trim(), @"^id\s*=\s*(\d+)\s*$", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
500:                     if (lm.Success)
501:                     {
502:                         id = lm.Groups[1].Value;
503:                         return true;
504:                     }
505:                 }
506:             }
507:         }
508:         catch
509:         {
510:             // Unreadable folder -- treat as unresolvable.
511:         }
512: 
513:         return false;
514:     }

517:     /// Normalizes a mod identifier for dependency matching: lowercase, remove
518:     /// spaces and punctuation, so "NeatUI_Framework" == "neatui framework" ==
519:     /// "NeatUI Framework" when comparing require= values against installed
520:     /// mods' id=/name= fields.
521:     /// </summary>
522:     private static string NormalizeModIdentifier(string value)
523:     {
524:         var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder(value.Length);
525:         foreach (var c in value)
526:         {
527:             if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c)) sb.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
528:         }
529:         return sb.ToString();

615:     /// <summary>
616:     /// Scans the mods folder, pulls live details from Steam for each mod,
617:     /// and determines which ones need an update -- this single pass now
618:     /// covers both "list what's installed" and "check for updates" (the
619:     /// tabs used to be separate; merged so there's one source of truth).
620:     /// </summary>
621:     private async Task RefreshDownloadedModsAsync()
622:     {
623:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_settings.ModsFolder) || !Directory.Exists(_settings.ModsFolder))
624:             return;
625: 
626:         AppendLog("Refreshing mod list and checking for updates...");
627:         var records = new List<ModRecord>();
628:         int updatesAvailable = 0;
629: 
630:         // Build an index of every installed mod's declared identifiers (id=/name=
631:         // from its mod.info) -> real workshop id (the numeric folder prefix), plus
632:         // the set of installed workshop ids. This lets require= entries (numeric
633:         // ids or internal names like "\NeatUI_Framework") be resolved purely
634:         // against what is already on disk -- no extra Steam API calls.
635:         var installedWorkshopIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
636:         var identifierIndex = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
637:         foreach (var dir in Directory.GetDirectories(_settings.ModsFolder))
638:         {
639:             if (!TryExtractWorkshopId(dir, out var knownId)) continue;
640:             installedWorkshopIds.Add(knownId);
641:             foreach (var ident in SteamCmdService.GetModIdentifiers(dir))
642:             {
643:                 var key = NormalizeModIdentifier(ident);
644:                 if (key.Length > 0) identifierIndex.TryAdd(key, knownId);
645:             }

# What the application is

A **Windows WPF (.NET 8) Steam Workshop browser and mod manager for Project Zomboid**. It embeds the Steam Workshop website, downloads mods via SteamCMD, installs them into the game's mods folder in PZ's expected layout, tracks installed mods, checks for updates, resolves dependencies, and manages uninstalls — all persisted locally under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\`.

**Project structure** (single-project, one NuGet dependency: `Microsoft.Web.WebView2`):

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `App.xaml` / `App.xaml.cs` | App entry: crash handling, control styles, theme + font-size resources |
| `MainWindow.xaml` / `.cs` | The hub (~1500 lines of code): all 5 tabs, queue, download flow, logging |
| `DepsDialog.xaml` / `.cs` | The "Show Dependencies" popup + `DepDisplay` row model |
| `AboutWindow.xaml` / `.cs` | Version/GitHub info dialog |
| `Services/` | Business logic (see below) |
| `Models/` | Plain display DTOs (`ModRecord`, `DownloadTask`, `QueueItem`, `UninstalledModEntry`, `LogEntry`, `DownloadHistoryEntry`) — INotifyPropertyChanged only where the UI updates in place (thumbnails, status) |
| `build.bat` / `run-debug.bat` | Publish (self-contained win-x64) / debug-run scripts |

## Services (the engine)

- **`SteamCmdService`** — downloads and mod.info parsing. On first use it auto-bootstraps: downloads the official `steamcmd.zip` from the Steam CDN into `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\steamcmd\`, extracts, and runs a harmless `+quit` once to absorb SteamCMD's self-update quirk. `DownloadModAsync` serializes all runs (a `SemaphoreSlim`, since SteamCMD can't run concurrently), runs `+force_install_dir … +login anonymous +workshop_download_item 108600 <id>`, then **re-lays the files out in PZ's real mod layout**: from Steam's cache `content/108600/<id>/mods/<ModFolder>` it copies to `<modsFolder>/<workshopId> <DisplayName>` (display name taken from mod.info's `name=`, sanitized). An item can contain several mod folders; items without a `mods/` subfolder are installed as-is. Nonzero exit codes are tolerated if files actually landed on disk. It also parses mod.info: `GetModDisplayName` (the `name=` field), `GetRequiresFields` (all `require=` values, splitting commas/semicolons, stripping the `\` prefix), and `GetModIdentifiers` (the letter-based `id=` and `name=` — used *only* to map `require=` references to installed mods, never to identify a mod).
- **`WorkshopApiService`** — Steam's public, key-less web API `ISteamRemoteStorage/GetPublishedFileDetails/v1`. Returns title, file size, created/updated timestamps, creator SteamID, and crucially the **`hcontent_file` "content manifest" id** — a manifest hash that changes when the actual file content changes, used as the real version token (deliberate choice over `time_updated`, which can shift for cosmetic edits). Tolerates Steam returning numbers as strings.
- **`WorkshopVisualService`** — same endpoint but batched (up to 100 ids per POST) fetching `preview_url` and `tags` for thumbnails and the tag filter.
- **`WorkshopPageService`** — scrapes the HTML of a mod's Workshop page, extracting the "Required items" section (a regex over `filedetails/?id=` links around `requiredItem` divs). This is the only place a name-only `require=` entry (`\NeatUI_Framework`) can be mapped to a real numeric workshop id + title. Browser-like UA header; best-effort, never fatal.
- **`ThumbnailStore`** — local disk cache `thumbnails\<workshopId>.jpg`; reused across runs, never throws.
- **`SettingsService`**, **`DownloadHistoryStore`** (capped at 300 entries), **`UninstalledModsStore`** — JSON load/save to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\` (settings, download_history, uninstalled_mods), all best-effort with corrupt-file fallbacks.

## MainWindow — how the pieces work together

**Layout**: a two-row grid. Row 0 = a `TabControl` (Browser / Downloads / Installed Mods / Uninstalled Mods / Settings) plus an auto-appearing **right-side queue panel** (column width animates 0→280). Row 1 (spans both columns) = **status bar + collapsible log panel** (an animated 260px-tall border; DEBUG-level lines — raw SteamCMD output — only shown if the debug setting is enabled; 500-entry cap; auto-scrolls only when the user is at the bottom, otherwise a "Jump to Bottom" button appears; per-level color coding).

**Browser tab**: an embedded `WebView2` pointed at the PZ Workshop browse page (`appid=108600`). Back/forward/home buttons, an address bar where plain text (non-URL) is turned into a Workshop *search* URL. The app reads the current page's `?id=(\d+)` from the URL and the document title, so when the user is on a mod's page, **"Download This Mod/Collection"** immediately runs the download pipeline, and **"Add To Queue"** parks it in the queue. Any "Open Mod Page" action from any tab navigates here.

**Download pipeline** (`StartDownloadAsync`, one shared code path for downloads, queue, updates, reinstalls):
1. Creates a `DownloadTask` row at the top of Downloads and persists history.
2. Kicks off a background thumbnail fetch.
3. `SteamCmdService.DownloadModAsync` downloads → re-lays files → returns installed folder(s).
4. Then calls the Steam API to record the current `hcontent_file` as this mod's **local version** and today's date as its install date (offline at that moment is fine — it just keeps the old record).
5. Updates status/status bar, saves history, refreshes the Installed Mods view.

**Downloads tab**: every download *attempt* (including retries) is a row — a simple activity log, persisted, with thumbnails, status, latest SteamCMD line, timestamps. Clear Finished / Clear All, right-click remove. **List/Tiles view toggle** plus a **tile-size slider** (updates the app-wide `ModTileSize` resource live) — a pattern repeated on all three mod lists; tiles show the thumbnail with an initial-letter placeholder and clickable-through to the mod page.

**Installed Mods tab** (list *and* update manager merged into one): `RefreshDownloadedModsAsync` scans the configured mods folder, resolving each folder to a workshop id from the **numeric prefix of the folder name** (fallback: a purely numeric `id=` in any mod.info). It then:
- Builds a local **identifier index** (normalized, lowercased, punctuation-stripped `id=`/`name=` values of every installed mod → their workshop id) so `require=` entries are resolved **purely on disk** — zero extra API calls.
- Queries Steam per mod for title, dates, creator, and the live content manifest.
- Computes `NeedsUpdate`: true if the local recorded manifest differs from Steam's, or if the mod was never tracked (e.g. hand-placed); **false** when Steam can't be reached (no false flags when offline).
- Fills dependency lists: each `require=` entry is checked as either a numeric installed-id or a normalized identifier match; misses go into `MissingDependencies`.

The grid shows thumbnail, folder, name, **update status** (green, or orange with a repeating opacity-pulse when an update is out), **requirements status** (same pulse pattern, `"N missing"`, or "Requirements Met"/"No Requirements"), tags, folder size, install date, local/Steam version, plus per-row buttons: 📂 open folder, 🔗 open page, ↻ update (only visible when `NeedsUpdate`), 🔄 force redownload, ⚙ show deps (visible when the mod declares deps), ✖ uninstall. A tag **filter sidebar** (collapsible) lists all Steam tags across installed mods; checking tags filters both the grid *and* the tile view through one shared `CollectionView` filter matching *any* selected tag (untagged mods always stay visible). "Update All" is enabled only when updates exist; it and the per-mod update both do the same thing: optional **backup** of the old folder into `_backups\<folder>\<timestamp>` (user setting), delete the old folder (avoids duplicate folders when Steam renames a subfolder), then re download. Export writes the mod list to an XML file; **Import** reads such a file and adds every not-yet-installed mod **to the queue** rather than auto-downloading.

**Dependency dialog** (`DepsDialog` via "⚙ Show Deps"): on demand, fetches the mod's Workshop page and parses its "Required items" section — this page is authoritative, so *every* requirement shows with its resolved workshop id and "Installed"/"Missing" annotation against the current installed set. If the page has no such section, it falls back to the local mod.info `require=` resolution. Per row: **Queue** (only for deps with a known numeric id), **Open Page** (navigates the embedded browser to the dep, or to a Steam *search* when only an internal name is known), and an "Add All to Queue" bulk button. Results are cached per session and duplicate in-flight fetches are dropped.

**Uninstalled Mods tab**: uninstalling a mod deletes its folder (with confirm) and records an `UninstalledModEntry` (id, name, author SteamID, date) to disk. This tab lists them with **Reinstall** (fresh download, removes the entry on success), **Open Page**, or **Forget**. Thumbnails are fetched the same way as elsewhere.

**Queue side panel**: hidden while empty; any "Add To Queue" (from the browser page or an import) makes it appear. "Start Downloading All" processes items **serially** (SteamCMD constraint), marking each Done/Failed; Clear Queue empties it.

## Cross-cutting systems

- **Theming**: 7 named brush resources (`BgDark`, `BgPanel`, `BgField`, `FgText`, `AccentBlue`, `AccentGreen`, `BorderCol`) referenced via `DynamicResource` everywhere. `ApplyTheme` picks one of **10 palettes** (Light, Dark, Midnight, Forest, Nord, Dracula, Solarized Dark/Light, Gruvbox, Monokai) and **replaces the brush resources entirely** — in-place `Color` mutation is deliberately avoided because WPF freezes XAML-declared brushes.
- **UI customization**: font sizes (general text, buttons, tab headers, log) are app-level `sys:Double` resources that every style binds to; the Settings sliders rewrite both the resource (live effect) and the persisted setting. "Reset UI to Defaults" restores them. Tile size is a similar live resource.
- **Settings persistence** (`settings.json`): mods folder, backup/auto-refresh/debug-logging checkboxes, theme, font sizes, plus `LocalModVersions` (workshopId → content manifest) and `InstallDates` (workshopId → timestamp) — the heart of the update check.
- **Identity rule** (visible throughout the code): the workshop id is **numeric** and comes from the folder-name prefix / page URL; the letter-based `id=` in mod.info is *only* used to resolve `require=` references locally.
- **Robustness**: `App` installs handlers for dispatcher, AppDomain, and unobserved-task exceptions — logs to `crash.log`, shows a message box, and keeps the app alive. Every network/parsing touchpoint (visuals, thumbnails, page scraping, manifest recording) is wrapped so a cosmetic or partial failure degrades to a placeholder/log line rather than a crash. SteamCMD stdout streams into both the per-task `Detail` column and the debug log, marshaled to the UI thread.

**Data layout on disk**: `settings.json`, `download_history.json`, `uninstalled_mods.json`, `crash.log`, `thumbnails/`, and `steamcmd/` (runtime + Steam content cache) — all under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PZWorkshopDownloader\`.

One notable integration decision: updates are detected by **content manifest comparison** (`hcontent_file`), not timestamps or version strings, and dependency checking is done **locally** (zero API calls during a refresh); the only per-mod remote work in the refresh is the single batched `GetPublishedFileDetails` per id plus the batched visual fetch.

Since `GitHubConfigured = true`, the disabled button message will no longer appear in the AboutWindow constructor. Also, `GitHubNoteText` in the XAML keeps its default text, but that's fine.

Next up is change 2: the tile size slider. Let me edit the 3 StackPanels in MainWindow.xaml. Need to give each slider an x:Name and a default Collapsed state, and each "TextBlock Tile size:" label needs a name too.

Downloads tab (lines 227-237):
```
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="DownloadsTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"
                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                    </StackPanel>
```

Installed tabs (lines 345-357):
```
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="InstalledTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"
                                      Checked="InstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>
                        <TextBlock Text="Tile size:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="14,0,4,0"
                                   Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Slider Width="140" Minimum="80" Maximum="260" Value="140"

                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                        <Button x:Name="TagSidebarToggle" Content="◀" Click="ToggleTagSidebar_Click"
                                Padding="8,3" Margin="14,0,0,0" ToolTip="Toggle tag filter sidebar"/>
                    </StackPanel>
```

Uninstalled tab (lines 619-630):
```
                    <StackPanel Grid.Row="1" Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="8,4,8,4">
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="UninstalledListToggle" Content="☰ List" Tag="List"
                                      IsChecked="True" Checked="UninstalledView_Checked" Padding="8,3"/>
                        <ToggleButton x:Name="UninstalledTilesToggle" Content="▦ Tiles" Tag="Tiles"

                                ValueChanged="ModTileSize_Changed" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                IsSnapToTickEnabled="True" TickFrequency="10"/>
                    </StackPanel>
```

Names: `DownloadsTileSizer`, `InstalledTileSizer`, `UninstalledTileSizer` for the sliders; `DownloadsTileSizeLabel`, etc. for the labels. Wait, simpler: just give names like "DownloadsTileSizer" — the TextBlock needs "Text:" to make the match unique.

Old:

                                      Checked="DownloadsView_Checked" Padding="8,3" Margin="4,0,0,0"/>

This is the unique match, because the DownloadsTilesToggle context disambiguates. But wait — isn't the TextBlock + Slider block identical between the Downloads tab and the Uninstalled tab (both without TagSidebarToggle)? Downloads ends with the Slider, and Uninstalled also ends with the Slider, and both are followed by `</StackPanel>`. So the oldString including DownloadsTilesToggle is unique. Good.

Edit 3 (Uninstalled): include the UninstalledTilesToggle line.

1. Fields:
```csharp
    private static readonly SemaphoreSlim ThumbnailGate = new(4);
    private bool _tagSidebarExpanded = true;
```
Add after the _tagSidebarExpanded declaration:
```csharp
    // Tile-size sliders/labels are visible only in tile mode.
    private (System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock Label, System.Windows.Controls.Slider Slider)? _tileSizers = null;
```
Hmm, a tuple of FrameworkElement? Should I do `private System.Windows.Controls.TextBlock[] _tileSizerLabels = System.Array.Empty<...>();`? A simpler explicit approach: 3 pairs of nullable fields initialized in the constructor after InitializeComponent:

```csharp
private TextBlock? _downloadsTileSizer;
private Slider? _downloadsTileSizeLabel...
```

This is verbose. Alternative single structure:

```csharp
// (label, slider) per tab — hidden while the tab is in list mode.
private (TextBlock label, Slider slider)[] _tileSizers = Array.Empty<(TextBlock, Slider)>();
```

In the constructor:
```csharp
_tileSizers = new[]
{
    (DownloadsTileSizeLabel, DownloadsTileSizer),
    (InstalledTileSizeLabel, InstalledTileSizer),
    (UninstalledTileSizeLabel, UninstalledTileSizer),
};
```

And in each Checked handler, after swapping visibility:
```csharp
SetTileSizerVisibility(DownloadsTileSizeLabel, DownloadsTileSizer, tiles);
```

Method:
```csharp
    // The tile-size slider (and its label) is only useful in tile mode;
    // hiding/showing it together with the view keeps the toolbar tidy in list mode.
    private static void SetTileSizerVisibility(TextBlock label, Slider slider, bool tiles)
    {
        var v = tiles ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        label.Visibility = v;
        slider.Visibility = v;
    }
```

Wait — is XAML's default Visibility honored even without the `IsLoaded` guard? Yes. I set Visibility="Collapsed" directly in the XAML, so the initial state is correct.

But note the constructor: the fields are null until set. The views are called from Checked handlers; the Downloads/Uninstalled/Installed Checked event during InitializeComponent fires without a problem (early return since IsLoaded is false). In the constructor, are we setting _tileSizers before any event could fire? The handlers early-return either way, so no problem.

2. Settings button. Two inserts:

First, before the "Options" section… let me pin down the location:

```

                    </StackPanel>

                    <TextBlock Text="Options" ...
```

After the StackPanel, add:
```
                    <Border Margin="0,0,0,24" Padding="10" Background="{DynamicResource BgPanel}"
                            BorderBrush="{DynamicResource BorderCol}" BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="6">
                        <TextBlock .../>
                        <Button .../>
                    </Border>
```
With StackPanel inside the Border for description + button. Design (matching the visual style of the rest of the app — panels use BgPanel background, FgText/Green accents):

```xaml
                    <!-- Workshop cache -->
                    <TextBlock Text="Workshop Cache" Foreground="{DynamicResource AccentBlue}"
                               FontWeight="Bold" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Cached downloads from SteamCMD are kept so re-downloading is faster while they may go stale. Clearing this only deletes the cached Workshop files — SteamCMD itself and your installed mods are untouched."
                               Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}" Opacity="0.7" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,0,0,8"/>
                    <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal" Margin="0,0,0,24">
                        <TextBlock Text="Cached items:" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="{DynamicResource FgText}"/>
                        <Button Content="Clear Cached Mods" Click="ClearWorkshopCache_Click"/>
                    </StackPanel>
```

Simple, matches the pattern (bold AccentBlue header + explanatory text + controls + 24 margin).

3. Handler in the code-behind, place it near PickModsFolder (Downloader tab section) or in the Settings toggles section. Since it's a Settings button, put it near the "Settings toggles / theme" section — right before `SettingsCheckbox_Changed`. Actually no, thematically it's closer to "Downloader tab: download actions" where PickModsFolder lives… The handler name is `ClearWorkshopCache_Click`. Put it after PickModsFolder:

```csharp
    private void ClearWorkshopCache_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        var cachePath = SteamCmdService.GetWorkshopContentCachePath();
        var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
            "Delete the cached Workshop downloads?",
            ...
```

Wait, MessageBox is also used for confirmation with MessageBoxButton.YesNo. Let's do this:

```csharp
    /// <summary>
    /// Settings action: clears SteamCMD's local cache of Workshop content
    /// (the raw downloaded copies under steamcmd\steamapps\workshop\content\108600).
    /// Only the cached files are deleted, not SteamCMD itself nor the installed
    /// mods folder. Always asks for confirmation first.
    /// </summary>
    private void ClearWorkshopCache_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(SteamCmdService.GetWorkshopContentCachePath()))
        {
            MessageBox.Show("There is no Workshop content cache to clear yet.");
            return;
        }

        var confirm = MessageBox.Show(
            "This deletes the cached Workshop mod downloads so SteamCMD has to re-download " +
            "them the next time you fetch a mod.\n\nSteamCMD itself and the mods in your mods " +
            "folder are not touched.\n\nClear the cache?",
            "Clear Workshop Cache", MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Warning);
        if (confirm != MessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

        try
        {
            SteamCmdService.ClearWorkshopContentCache();
            StatusText.Text = "Workshop cache cleared.";
            AppendLog("Cleared cached Workshop content (steamcmd content folder).");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            MessageBox.Show($"Could not clear the Workshop cache: {ex.Message}");
            AppendLog($"FAILED to clear the Workshop cache: {ex.Message}", "ERROR");
        }
    }
```

Hmm, "if there's no cache" — showing a MessageBox for the informational case is a bit heavy, but it's consistent with how the app communicates (MessageBox is used all over the place). Or just log + status. For simplicity I'll use MessageBox — the rest of the app is chatty, so it fits the app's tone. Hmm, but is a "Clear" button that does nothing and pops an error weird? It's fine, it's informative. Actually I could simplify further: make ClearWorkshopContentCache just do nothing when it doesn't exist, and on the UI side just always prompt. The "no cache yet" case is rare. Let's keep the early-out messagebox — it's useful feedback.

Wait, one consideration: should the clear happen on a background thread? Deleting a large folder tree blocks the UI thread. The cache folder can get large (all the downloaded item folders). Directory.Delete recursive on several hundred MB can take a few seconds and freeze the UI. Better: run it in the background with a small async wrapper? The app's pattern is "services are async, the window awaits, blocks when needed". A synchronous Directory.Delete in a UI handler = UI freeze risk. Make the handler async void, run the deletion on a background task, show a status update:

```csharp
    private async void ClearWorkshopCache_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
    {
        ...confirm...
        try
        {
            StatusText.Text = "Clearing Workshop cache...";
            await Task.Run(SteamCmdService.ClearWorkshopContentCache);
            StatusText.Text = "Workshop cache cleared.";
            AppendLog("Cleared cached Workshop content (steamcmd content folder).");
        }
        ...
    }
```

This is good and matches the style of the async void handlers used everywhere.

4. Also add "Workshop cache" — does the cache-clear need to be aware of in-flight downloads? If SteamCMD is mid-download and the user clears the cache, it could fail with a weird error but is recoverable (re-download). No need to handle it.

Note about the visibility of the initial list mode: In the current XAML, List is checked by default (IsChecked="True"), and `*_View_Checked` runs at InitializeComponent, but it early-returns via `if (!IsLoaded) return;`. The tiles toggle's own Checked handler does all the work (hiding the grid, showing the tiles, showing the slider). Behavior unchanged from before, just the slider visibility added. Switching back to List: the user clicks List → List's Checked fires, tiles gets unchecked, the grid is shown, the tiles hidden, and the slider hidden.
